CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
Dim boolEnter As Boolean


Private Sub Data_AfterUpdate()
FelDoc = fMail2021(DLookup("VL", "CFGs", "F='CH' AND CFG='Explicatie'"))
If Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub!ValoareTotala > 0 Then Plata = Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub!ValoareTotala

End Sub

Private Sub Data_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Data, "") = "" Then
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
    Exit Sub
End If

If Month(Data) <> DLookup("Luna", "LunaD", "IDL= " & Forms!prezenta!IDL) Then
    MsgBox "Atentie! Documentul de plata TREBUIE sa fie din luna selectata!!!" & vbCrLf & "Pentru a introduce un document de avans, trebuie salvata prezenta pentru luna respectiva!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
End If

End Sub

Private Sub FelDoc_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Me.Data, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Trebuie sa completezi campul [DATA] mai intai!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Form_AfterInsert()
If Murdar Then
    If MsgBox("Nu ai salvat documentul!" & vbCrLf & "Doresti sa il salvezi?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbYes Then
        MsgBox "Apasa pe discheta din dreapta randului!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Else
        Me.Recordset.FindFirst "IDPL = " & CL
        Me.Recordset.Delete
        Murdar = False
    End If
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Plata_AfterUpdate()
If Nz(Plata, "") <> "" Then Plata = CInt(Plata)

End Sub

Private Sub Plata_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Me.Data, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Trebuie sa completezi campul [DATA] mai intai!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Sav_Click()
If MsgBox("Doresti salvarea documentului curent?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Sub

Me.Murdar = False
If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False
Me.Murdar = True

Dim RC As DAO.Recordset, TC As DAO.Recordset
Dim Bkm As Variant

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM tmpPlatiAlte WHERE ID = " & Me!ID)

If Not POP(RC) Then
    MsgBox "Eroare la salvare!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If RC!Salvata Then
    MsgBox "Documentul este salvat deja!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If Nz(NrDoc, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Nu poti lasa campul [Numar Document] gol!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If Nz(FelDoc, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Nu poti lasa campul [Explicatie] gol!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If Nz(Plata, 0) = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Nu poti salva o plata fara suma!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Plati", 2)

TC.AddNew
    TC!IDPL = RC!IDPL
    TC!IDP = RC!IDP
    TC!IDZ = RC!IDZ
    TC!IDS = RC!IDS
    TC!IDL = RC!IDL
    TC!Data = RC!Data
    TC!Plata = RC!Plata
    TC!TIP = 1
    TC!Valid = True
TC.Update

Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("AlteDoc", 2)

TC.AddNew
    TC!IDA = RC!IDA
    TC!IDPL = RC!IDPL
    TC!DataDoc = RC!Data
    TC!NrDoc = RC!NrDoc
    TC!FelDoc = RC!FelDoc
TC.Update

If Forms!prezenta!Inchisa Then
    Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM SS_Buget WHERE IDZ=" & Forms!prezenta!IDZ, 2)
    TC.Edit
        TC!Plati = TC!Plati + RC!Plata
        TC!Compensare = IIf(TC!SID > 0, 0, IIf(TC!Plata + TC!Plati > 0, IIf((TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati)) < 0, 0, TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati)), IIf(TC!SIC > TC!ValoareContract, TC!ValoareContract, TC!SIC)))
        TC!Anticipat = IIf((TC!Plata + TC!Plati - TC!ValoareContract - TC!SID) > 0, TC!Plata + TC!Plati - TC!SID - TC!ValoareContract, 0)
        TC!Detalii = TC!Detalii & ";VI:" & RC!NrDoc
        TC!SFD = IIf((TC!SID - TC!SIC) + TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati - Nz(TC!Retur, 0)) > 0, (TC!SID - TC!SIC) + TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati - Nz(TC!Retur, 0)), 0)
        TC!SFC = IIf((TC!SID - TC!SIC) + TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati - Nz(TC!Retur, 0)) < 0, Abs((TC!SID - TC!SIC) + TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati - Nz(TC!Retur, 0))), 0)
        If TC!Compensare > 0 Then If TC!SIC > 0 And TC!SFD > 0 Then TC!Compensare = TC!SIC
    TC.Update
End If

MsgBox "Documentul a fost salvat cu succes!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation

Call IncarcaPrezenta(True)

IESIRE:
Set RC = Nothing
Set TC = Nothing

Murdar = False

End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Forms!prezenta!IDP, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Alege copilul caruia vrei sa ii inregistrezi o plata!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
    Exit Sub
End If

If Forms!prezenta!IDL + 1 < DMax("IDL", "Prezenta") Then
    MsgBox "Nu se mai pot adauga documente decat in luna prezenta sau anterioara!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
    Exit Sub
End If

IDPL = Nz(DMax("IDPL", "Plati"), 0) + 1
CL = IDPL
IDZ = Forms!prezenta!IDZ
IDP = Forms!prezenta!IDP
IDS = DLookup("IDS", "Platitori_sub", "Activ=True AND IDP=" & IDP)
IDL = Forms!prezenta!IDL
TIP = "2"
IDA = Nz(DMax("ida", "AlteDoc"), 0) + 1

Murdar = True
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
If Nz(Murdar, False) Then
    Me.Recordset.FindFirst "IDPL=" & CL
    Exit Sub
End If

Murdar = False

CL = Me.IDPL
Forms!prezenta!IDPL = Me.IDPL

End Sub


Private Sub Form_Load()
GolesteTabel , "Plati", "Valid=False"

End Sub


Private Sub Plata_MouseUp(Button As Integer, Shift As Integer, x As Single, y As Single)
    With Plata
        .SetFocus
        .SelStart = 0
        .SelLength = Len(.Text)
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub Del_Click()
On Error GoTo Eroare

Dim RC As DAO.Recordset
Dim Bkm As Variant

If Anulata Then
    MsgBox "Plata selectata este anulata!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If
    
If Forms!prezenta!IDL + 1 < DMax("IDL", "Prezenta") Then
    MsgBox "Nu se pot anula documente decat in luna prezenta sau cea anterioara!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Exit Sub
End If
    
If CBool(Nz(DLookup("VL", "CFGS", "F='XX' AND CFG='CodAnulare'"), False)) Then
    Dim Cod As String
    Cod = InputBox("Completeaza codul pentru anulare!" & vbCrLf & "Valoare 1: " & Me.NrDoc & vbCrLf & "Valoare 2: " & Me.Data, "Anuleaza document...", "")
    If Cod <> MakeCod(Me.NrDoc, Me.Data) Then
        MsgBox "Codul nu corespunde!" & vbCrLf & "Anulare esuata!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
End If

Dim Motiv As String
Motiv = InputBox("Completeaza motivul pentru care anulezi documentul curent!", "Motivul anularii")
If Nz(Motiv, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Documentele NU pot fi anulate fara motiv!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
End If
    
If MsgBox("Platile NU pot fi sterse, decat anulate!" & vbCrLf & "Doresti anularea platii " & NrDoc & "/" & FelDoc & "?" & vbCrLf & "ATENTIE! ODATA ANULATA, PLATA NU MAI POATE FI RESTAURATA!", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Sub
        
Anulata = True

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM AlteDoc WHERE IDA = " & Me!IDA, 2)
    RC.Edit
        RC!Anulata = True
    RC.Update

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM Plati WHERE IDPL = " & Me!IDPL, 2)
    RC.Edit
        RC!Anulata = True
        RC!motivul = Motiv
    RC.Update

Me.Recalc
        
MsgBox "Documentul a fost anulat!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
        
Call IncarcaPrezenta(True)
       
IESIRE:
Set RC = Nothing

Exit Sub
   
Eroare:
    DebugPrint Err.Description, "Forms/Plati_Alte/Del_Click()", True
    Resume IESIRE
End Sub
